body: Hey! I'm trying to compute the result of multiple kernel ridge regressions in a parallel mode. I've wrote the code and created jax expressions of my functions using `jax.make_jaxpr`. According to the jax expressions, the data and computation should fit into my GPU (I'm using 4 V100 GPU with 16GB of RAM on each, which amounts to 64GB of GPU RAM), and they should be very far from the actual limits of what I have, but surprisingly, it throws and OOM. (I'm using 64bit precision) Basically, what I expect from the jax expressions is that the most expensive item here (memory-wise) should be the 4000 x 2000 x 10 x 10 along with the 20000x20000 matrix that are broadcasted on each GPU, which amounts to ~9GB of GPU RAM, but other than that, I can't see why this code can't fit in the GPU.
